$comment: Real WGS84 geography in plain [lon, lat] degrees. NOTHING here is projected or in pixels: sim/geography.ts runs these through the same plate carree project() the cities go through, which is why a city sits on its own coast without anyone placing it by hand. Longitude deliberately spans the whole -180..180 world, because that is what round-the-world scrolling needs (see WORLD_COPIES/wrapPanX in sim/geography.ts). Replaced an earlier Ptolemaic chart, which was authentic but visibly skewed and, being a bounded rectangle rather than a globe, could not wrap. Regenerate with packages/niccolo/scripts/build_chart.py; do NOT hand-edit these rings. 'seas' are interior rings (enclosed water) drawn over the land.
